English.Char_Desc_2000:
DiskInsight shows exactly where your disk space went.
It renders any drive as a treemap, sunburst, flame graph, bubbles, mind map or age map, so you can see at a glance which folders and files are responsible for a full disk. Instant search filters every view, the large-files list points straight at the biggest offenders, and a live monitor keeps an eye on free space while you work.
Free features: - Nine visualizers: treemap, sunburst, flame, bubbles, mind map, age map, top sizes, list, folders - Instant search across the whole disk - Large-file and old-file lists - Live system monitor with free-space alerts - Quick Wins report with the biggest reclaimable items
DiskInsight Pro is a one-time $9.99 unlock (no subscription) that adds cleanup tools: - Content-hash duplicate detection - Developer cache cleaner (Xcode DerivedData, npm, CocoaPods, Gradle) - Complete app uninstaller
Everything runs locally. DiskInsight does not upload file names, folder structures or usage data anywhere, and it works without an account.
Typical uses: finding what filled your drive after a big Photos or Xcode import, spotting duplicate downloads, clearing node_modules and DerivedData caches, and uninstalling apps you no longer use together with their leftovers.
Requirements: macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later on Apple Silicon or Intel Macs. Full Disk Access is needed only to scan protected folders, and the app explains every permission it asks for.

Permissions.Distribution_Permissions: Free to distribute. The optional Pro features are unlocked with a one-time license key.
